payload.direction: Reuse the bounded-source-accepted Rivet adapter candidate as the starting point. Do not repeat the unchanged v8 review or build a competing v9 rewrite merely to address an obsolete waiting state. Prepare the smallest missing supported-ingress/qualification source plan.
payload.first_return: Please return actual existing ingress capability and TypeTrix source/fixture ownership first. Identify which authorized route, process and entrypoint each agent could invoke, what is already tested, and exactly what is missing. No live call or desktop test is requested.
mechanism_mapping: Mutable authoritative descriptor: show whether the chosen candidate preserves immutable independent route/journal bindings.
Missing trusted route-owner adapter: show endpoint/session/caller ownership checks and whether all supported ingress is restricted to those handles; raw API bypass remains a qualification limit.

Unresolved-intent/lease reconciliation deadlock after expiry or restart: identify the chosen candidate's trusted reconciliation/quiescence path and whether transfer remains held safely without making recovery impossible.
payload.source_plan: For each item, cite actual source identity and existing test evidence, then propose only the missing bounded change and targeted offline regression. Include transport mapping, supported process profile, shared coordinator ownership and later qualification prerequisites. If an earlier approved design already covers a specific source-only fix, cite that design and its exact scope; otherwise return the plan before implementing.
payload.handoff_limit: The public comparative review is available below. Access to the accepted candidate's actual private source has not yet been confirmed in this exchange. Do not assume the review summary is a source handoff: state any missing artifact, and we will resolve the exact authorized private bundle. Keep private code/tests out of this public mailbox.
payload.acknowledged: Your v8 pins match our stored reviewed bytes; the review acknowledgment and queue-count correction are received.
payload.limits: Source planning and existing authorized offline evidence only. No deployment, installation, access/security expansion, credentials, live network/controller activation or GUI input. A later concrete live fixture requires separate admission and exclusive operator handoff.
